title: Telehealth Follow-Up Visit Copay
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — telehealth services terms**

These terms apply when visits the member's own primary care provider billed under the specialist visit copay are re-rated as primary care visits. They read the visit log of the member's current assignment in the Primary Care Provider Assignment records, over the 12-month re-rating window counted back from the review date (a visit date counts when it lies fewer than 12 whole months before the review date).

## Term

For each telehealth follow-up the current assignment's visit log records in the 12-month window — a visit logged with visit type follow-up and visit mode telehealth — one re-rated visit re-rates at:

- **0.00 USD**, the medical-home telehealth follow-up copay, when the current practice is a medical-home practice (a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or a Federally Qualified Health Center Home);
- **1.00 USD**, the other-practice telehealth follow-up copay, when the current practice is of any other type.

With no telehealth follow-up logged in the window, no visit re-rates under this term.

## Condition and result

| Telehealth follow-ups on the current assignment's log in the window | Current practice | Re-rated copay for that many visits |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 0.00 each |
| One or more | Any other practice type | 1.00 each |
| None | Any | No visit re-rated under this term |

Only the current assignment's log is read: a telehealth follow-up logged under an ended assignment, an in-person follow-up, and a telehealth visit of another visit type are not counted. The number of visits rated under this term equals the number of telehealth follow-ups counted.

## Hypothetical illustration

Inputs chosen for illustration only. Four visits are being re-rated; the current assignment's log shows 2 telehealth follow-ups in the window and 1 more logged 14 months before the review date.

- Counted telehealth follow-ups: 2 (the one 14 months back is outside the window).
- Current practice a Federally Qualified Health Center Home: 2 of the four visits re-rate at 0.00 each.
- Current practice a Standard Primary Care Provider: 2 of the four visits re-rate at 1.00 each, together 2.00.
- The other 2 visits are not re-rated under this term.
